reconnect_policy: Treat every disconnect as a possible event gap. Establish a new WebSocket API connection and a new signature subscription; never assume replay.
gap_recovery_policy: After reconnect, query every tracked order and the authenticated account through REST before accepting new execution events.
duplicate_policy: Hash the complete subscription wrapper, suppress exact duplicates across connections, and retain the duplicate count in evidence.
ambiguous_outcome_policy: Resolve uncertain REST order entry by deterministic client order ID. Never blindly resubmit an order whose exchange outcome is unknown.
cleanup_policy: Cancel only a proven open campaign order by deterministic identity. Any fill, unresolved order, nonzero trade ledger, or balance drift fails Phase 2C.
